description: NI-027 cohort scope declarations for the existing research archive. Values are transcribed from each cohort's README.md and manifest.json plus docs/SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md; they bound what imported rows may claim and never extend the archive's own scope. Window boundaries are UTC dates; intervals are [start, end).

SRC-BQ.name: NEAR public BigQuery dataset
lineage: Saved execution_outcomes/receipt_actions exports cover the archived cohorts; re-execution requires cloud identity and is not scheduled (docs/SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md SRC-BQ)

SRC-DASHBOARD.name: revenue.near.org captured public pages
lineage: Saved HTML/RSC/JSON snapshots are captured third-party material, not independently verified metrics (docs/SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md SRC-DASHBOARD)

SRC-FASTNEAR.name: FastNear indexed transactions and accounts
lineage: Local 30-day role-index audit recorded exhausted pagination; index-head lag is not quantified (docs/SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md SRC-FASTNEAR)

SRC-INTENTS.name: Explorer API swap records and fee declarations
lineage: Creation-cohort exports are documented; current endpoint auth/quota entitlement remains probe pending (docs/SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md SRC-INTENTS)
appFees declarations are not executed revenue

SRC-LLAMA.name: DefiLlama reported fees, volume and adapter methodology
lineage: Provider-reported series; the public adapter maps Dune inputs and selected wallet flows and is not independent confirmation (docs/SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md SRC-LLAMA)

SRC-NEAR-RPC.name: NEAR mainnet JSON-RPC
lineage: OQ-03 RESOLVED operator authorization 2026-11-06: free tier, no account/key, header-only, byte caps (PR #28 probe evidence)
Historical archival RPC audit stopped on HTTP429 after 6 of 297 headers; stopped collectors are not restarted

SRC-NEARBLOCKS.name: NEARBlocks indexed charts and boundaries
lineage: Secondary reconciliation source; current API entitlement/quota/history/license unverified (docs/SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md SRC-NEARBLOCKS)

SRC-PRICE.name: CoinGecko NEAR/USD historical prices
lineage: Saved daily points cover the analysis window; daily USD valuations are approximations, not execution prices (docs/SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md SRC-PRICE)

near-dollar.partial_audit: Daily USD values are provider-price approximations, not execution prices; volume and fees are provider-reported, not independently reconstructed from all exchanges.

near-longitudinal.partial_audit: 90-day BigQuery export covers saved rows only; dataset completeness for the window is not proven; legacy payout matching used up to 300s tolerance.

near-pilot.partial_audit: Single-day bounded pilot: three wallets, 26 receipt actions, 124 second-export records; the FT-events check is recorded as a UI observation, not a full balance-change audit.

near-provenance.partial_audit: Creation cohort 2026-11-01..03 with 21,361 SUCCESS affiliate records (pagination complete) plus bounded 2026-11-01..02 on-chain matching and 2026-10-27..11-02 inventory bounds; full 90-day economic attribution is NOT identified (manifest status BOUNDED_PROVENANCE_ESTABLISHED_FULL_90D_NOT_IDENTIFIED).

near-supply.partial_audit: Exact net supply change verified at four boundaries; gross issuance and burn are LOWER bounds - the RPC header audit stopped on HTTP429 after 6 of 297 headers and collectors stay stopped (OQ-10).

near-treasury.partial_audit: 30-day FastNear role-index history with exhausted pagination plus one pinned RPC state slice at 2026-11-04T11:31:03Z (height 223010763); staking/lockup are not exhaustively audited.

near-weekly.partial_audit: Seven-day balance reconciliation covers observed account/asset pairs plus wrap.near only; five intent-hash mismatches remain unresolved (PROVIDER_QUESTIONS.md draft); STOP_PUBLIC_COLLECTION is present and collectors stay stopped.

revenue-dashboard.partial_audit: Captured third-party public pages of revenue.near.org as of 2026-11-03; the cohort ships no manifest.json; server-side methodology is not verified and captured rows are not independently verified metrics.
